title: Reverse Genetics Assembly of Newcastle Disease Virus Genome Template Using BioBrick Strategy
author: Tavassoli, Soleymani, et al.
materials: The allantoic fluids including the viral RNA of the NDV were subjected to RNA isolation using Total RNA purification kit (Jena Bioscience Co., Germany) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Afterward, the extracted viral RNA was transcribed to cDNA with random hexamer primers using AcuuPower RT PreMix (Bioneer Co., Korea). Briefly, a total of 250 ng viral RNA was added to each AccuPower CycleScript RT PreMix (dN6) tube, subsequently filled up to 20 μL with DEPC water. The lyophilized premix pellet was dissolved by taping the tube and vortexing. cDNA was synthesized in 12 cycles of 20 °C for 30 S, 43 °C for 4 min, and 55 °C for 30 S. At the end, the RT enzyme was heat-inactivated at 95 °C for 5 min. In order to obtain the complete coding sequence of the F gene, the PCR amplification was performed using Phusion High-Fidelity PCR Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc., USA) with the following thermocycling conditions; 98 °C for 30 S, followed by 33 cycles (98 °C for 10 S, 60 °C for 20 S, and 72 °C for 20 S/kb) and a final extension step of 7 min at 72 °C. The PCR reaction components were 2 μL cDNA, 1 μL forward and reverse primers (10 μM), 0.4 μL dNTPs (10 μM), 4 μL Phusion HF buffer (5X), DMSO 0.6 μL, 0.2 μL Phusion DNA Polymerase, and dH2O to 20 μL final volume. PCR primers used in this study were designed according to the consensus sequences of F genes from the GenBank database of the National Center for Biotechnology Information and using AlleleID software (version 7). The primers are listed in Supplementary Table S4.

steps.title: Isolate viral RNA from allantoic fluid
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from allantoic fluid containing NDV using the Total RNA purification kit (Jena Bioscience, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA using random hexamers
steps.instruction: Convert 250 ng of extracted viral RNA to cDNA with random hexamer primers using AccuPower RT PreMix (Bioneer, Korea).

substeps.instruction: Add 250 ng viral RNA to an AccuPower CycleScript RT PreMix (dN6) tube and bring the volume to 20 µL with DEPC‑treated water.
Vortex to dissolve the lyophilized pellet.
Run the reverse‑transcription program: 20 °C for 30 s, 43 °C for 4 min, 55 °C for 30 s (12 cycles).
Heat‑inactivate the RT enzyme at 95 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Amplify F gene by high‑fidelity PCR
steps.instruction: PCR‑amplify the complete coding sequence of the F gene from the cDNA using Phusion High‑Fidelity PCR Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL reaction containing: 2 µL cDNA, 1 µL forward primer (10 µM), 1 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 0.4 µL dNTPs (10 µM), 4 µL Phusion HF buffer (5X), 0.6 µL DMSO, 0.2 µL Phusion DNA polymerase, and water to 20 µL.
Thermocycle: 98 °C for 30 s; 33 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 60 °C for 20 s, 72 °C for 20 s per kb; final extension 72 °C for 7 min.

steps.title: Run agarose gel and purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Separate the PCR amplicon on a 1 % agarose gel and purify the band.

substeps.instruction: Load the PCR reaction onto a 1 % agarose gel and run electrophoresis.
Visualize the band, excise it, and purify using the AccuPrep® Gel Purification Kit (Bioneer, Korea) according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Submit purified product for Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Send the purified F‑gene PCR product for bidirectional Sanger sequencing (Macrogen Inc., South Korea).

steps.title: Analyze sequences and construct phylogenetic tree
steps.instruction: Assemble, edit, and phylogenetically analyse the F‑gene sequences.

substeps.instruction: Assemble forward and reverse reads and edit the consensus sequence using BioEdit.
Align the complete ORF (nt 1–1662) of each isolate.
Build a phylogenetic tree in MEGA X using the neighbor‑joining method with the Kimura 2‑parameter model and 500 bootstrap replicates.
Record GenBank accession numbers (MG519855, MG519856, MG519857) for reference.
